text_block_list.text:
I won, Trainer!!
I grabbed 1st place with my own two hands!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You better have burned it into your memory!
The sight of me at my absolute coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The sweet nectar of victory, huh!
Yeah, yeah, sounds pretty rad!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Still, though...
Lemme tell you one thing, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna celebrate this wildly over something so small,
one body won't be enough to survive it, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Fufun... This victory is
nothin' more than another milestone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The path to honing your coolness—
never has an end, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep running as far as I can!
Revving my engine and keeping the pedal to the metal!!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, Trainer. Why're you stating the obvious like it's news?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
From here on out, the stage is all mine!
I'm gonna run circles around 'em with my wicked style!
choice_data_list: That's quite a lot of confidence!
That's quite a lot of confidence!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's like a vow to myself.
If I end up losing—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'd be letting down you,
everyone cheering for me, all of 'em.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
There's no way in hell
I'm gonna embarrass myself like that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to it, Trainer!
I'm gonna keep bein' totally cool forever and ever!!
